title: mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/clodex-ide
claim: mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/clodex-ide — Local-first, zero-trust agentic IDE for verifiable autonomous software development.
why_good: A local-first, zero-trust agentic IDE built around verifiable autonomous development — bets teams want agents that PROVE their changes, not just make them.
value: Sell a team/enterprise tier (verification, audit, on-prem) to orgs that can't let autonomous agents run unchecked.
risk: 'Verifiable autonomous dev' is a big promise; Cursor/Claude Code own the IDE surface and can add verification.

zh.claim: mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/clodex-ide —— 本地优先、零信任的智能体 IDE,面向可验证的自主软件开发。
zh.why_good: 一个本地优先、零信任、围绕可验证自主开发的智能体 IDE——押注团队想要能证明自己改动、而非只是改的 agent。
zh.value: 给不能让自主 agent 无监督乱跑的组织卖团队/企业版(验证、审计、本地部署)。
zh.risk: 可验证自主开发是个大承诺;Cursor/Claude Code 掌握 IDE 入口,也能加验证。
zh.hook: 单人开发的智能体 IDE，主打『可验证的自主开发』——tracker 里还看不到任何外部用户。
zh.does: 本地优先、零信任的智能体 IDE，要求 agent 证明自己的改动：发布流水线里有署名、SBOM 与溯源门。亮点：单人项目里罕见的认真供应链卫生。
zh.gap: 『agent 要能证明自己干的活』是真需求，但没有任何一手证据表明有人在用这个实现——issue 和 PR 全是作者本人和 dependabot。
zh.counter: Cursor 和 Claude Code 占着 IDE 场地，验证功能一个 feature 就能补上；完整 IDE 单人做不动，859 星没有产生一个可见用户。
zh.differentiator: 暂时没有——留档，作为『验证/溯源正在成为 agent 工具卖点』的能力信号。

hook: A solo-built agentic IDE promising 'verifiable autonomous development' — no external users visible in the tracker yet.
pick_reason: The project is too vague and lacks a clear business model or product offering.
does: Local-first, zero-trust agentic IDE where agents must prove their changes: attribution, SBOM and provenance gates in the release pipeline. Standout: unusually serious supply-chain hygiene for a solo project.
gap: 'Agents that prove their work' is a real need, but there is no first-hand evidence anyone uses this implementation — every issue and PR is the author or dependabot.
counter: Cursor and Claude Code own the IDE surface and can add verification as a feature; a full IDE is out of solo reach and the 859 stars have produced zero visible users.
differentiator: None yet — archived as a capability signal that verification/provenance is becoming a selling point in agent tooling.
